name: Mobile Menu
description: A full-screen modal navigation flyout with native dialog focus and explicit dismissal.

accessibility.semantics: Native dialog with aria-labelledby and a labeled nav; links retain navigation semantics, never role=menu.
accessibility.keyboard: Native modal containment plus SiteKit Tab wrap, Escape dismissal and opener focus restoration. Opening focuses the close button.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings; explicit close button; active opener gets aria-expanded.
notes: Background scrolling is locked while open. Link activation closes the flyout.
Reduced motion disables the enter animation.
No-JS consumers must provide a visible navigation fallback.

responsive.strategy: Full viewport at any host width using logical dimensions and dynamic viewport height; content scrolls inside the dialog. Consumers choose when to expose the trigger.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.notes: Use the optional script to open the modal. Keep equivalent navigation visible when JavaScript is unavailable.

behavior.keyboard: Native dialog behavior handles focus; the optional layer explicitly restores focus, traps Tab, and handles Escape.
behavior.dismissal: Close button, Escape or activation of a contained navigation link. Scroll lock follows dialog open state; dispose closes an open dialog.

binding.html: native open for nonmodal; showModal() for modal

default.notes: Full viewport navigation; no visual variants yet.

guidance.use: Use a full-screen navigation flyout for compact site headers. Supply ordinary links and an explicit close button.
guidance.avoid: Context menus, nonmodal side panels, or application dialogs that are not navigation.

title.content: Trusted semantic HTML; links must be real navigation anchors. Escape text data.

links.content: Trusted semantic HTML; links must be real navigation anchors. Escape text data.
